samples.summary: Pointer-cursor feedback is applied on every mount, including the read-only grids that deliberately opted out of click-to-open
samples.evidence: `handleMouseMove` sets `scrollContainer.style.cursor = 'pointer'` whenever `pointerOverLink`, with no check of `readOnly`/`openLinksOnClick` (packages/sheets/src/view/worksheet.ts:3542-3547). The other engine mounts — packages/frontend/src/app/spreadsheet/datasource-view.tsx:62, packages/frontend/src/app/spreadsheet/lakehouse-view.tsx:111, packages/frontend/src/components/history/revision-preview.tsx:783 — now paint link spans and turn the cursor into a hand over them, but a plain click there only selects (the guard at worksheet.ts:3694-3699 requires `openLinksOnClick`), and none of them register `onLinkHover`, so no card explains the modifier. The affordance says clickable where a click does nothing.

samples.summary: Link colors hardcoded in the popover duplicate the engine theme constants and will drift
samples.evidence: `text-[#1A73E8] ... dark:text-[#8AB4F8]` in SheetLinkPopover.tsx:47 restates `cellLinkColor` from packages/sheets/src/view/theme.ts:10 (light `#1A73E8`) and :51 (dark `#8AB4F8`). A change to the engine's link color repaints the cell but not the card, and nothing links the two sites.

samples.summary: Zoom-scaled grid-boundary check introduced only for the link paths; sibling hit tests in the same handlers still compare raw header constants
samples.evidence: The change replaces the raw `x > RowHeaderWidth && y > DefaultCellHeight` test with `isInsideGrid` (zoom-scaled) for the link branch only. The checkbox/list-arrow branch immediately below still compares raw (packages/sheets/src/view/worksheet.ts:3713-3718), as do the peer-cursor hover test (worksheet.ts:3554) and `updateValidationTooltip` (worksheet.ts:2231). At zoom != 1 the 'inside the grid' boundary now differs per feature within one mousedown/mousemove, which is exactly the class of bug the new helper's own doc comment describes.

samples.summary: Link hover card is not dismissed when other engine popovers or the cell editor open
samples.evidence: Every other place that opens an engine popover clears the sibling hover artifact — `showListPopover` (worksheet.ts:1838) and `showDatePopover` (worksheet.ts:2029) both call `hideValidationTooltip()`, and the filter panel / context-menu paths do likewise — but none of them calls the new `resetLinkHover()`. `updateLinkHover` runs on every mount regardless of `readOnly`/`openLinksOnClick`, so a card opened by hover can outlive the hover and float over a freshly opened list/date popover, filter panel, context menu, or the cell input after a double-click (no mousemove follows those gestures, and `handleMouseDown` only resets when it actually opened a link, worksheet.ts:3703).
searchedFor: grep hideValidationTooltip() call sites in worksheet.ts
grep resetLinkHover call sites in packages/sheets/src

samples.summary: 'Mod+Click' breaks the catalog's documented key-token contract consumed by the help modal
samples.evidence: The catalog header states keys are keyboard tokens — Mod/Shift/Alt, named keys, printable letters (packages/sheets/src/view/shortcuts-catalog.ts:1-14) — and its consumer renders each token through `formatCombo` in packages/frontend/src/app/spreadsheet/sheets-shortcuts-help.tsx:29, which is built for key caps, not a mouse verb. The sibling catalogs in docs and slides have tests asserting properties over `keys` (packages/docs/test/view/shortcuts-catalog.test.ts:31, packages/slides/test/view/editor/shortcuts-catalog.test.ts:31); sheets has none, so the drift is silent. The read-only plain-click behavior is also absent from the catalog.

mergedFrom.summary: Only SheetView wires `onLinkHover`; other Spreadsheet mounts get the pointer/click behaviour without the hover card

finding.summary: Read-only engine mounts outside SheetView inherit the new "plain click opens the link" behaviour and lose cell selection
finding.evidence: `handleMouseDown` now opens a link on an unmodified left click whenever `this.readOnly` is true (packages/sheets/src/view/worksheet.ts:3678-3691) and `return`s before the selection path. Three other frontend surfaces mount the engine with `readOnly: true` and were not considered: `packages/frontend/src/app/spreadsheet/datasource-view.tsx:65`, `packages/frontend/src/app/spreadsheet/lakehouse-view.tsx:114`, and `packages/frontend/src/components/history/revision-preview.tsx:474`. In the datasource/lakehouse result grids the cell contents are arbitrary query results, so a row holding a URL can no longer be selected or copied — a plain click navigates the user away to a third-party origin instead. The revision preview (a dialog) likewise navigates away on a click that used to select. The fix probably belongs on the new code: gate the modifier-free open on something the host opts into, rather than on `readOnly`.

verdict.reason: The finding claims the plain-click hyperlink open is gated on `this.readOnly` alone, so every read-only mount inherits it. The actual condition at packages/sheets/src/view/worksheet.ts:3694-3699 is `((this.readOnly && this.openLinksOnClick) || e.ctrlKey || e.metaKey)` — it requires an explicit per-mount opt-in field `openLinksOnClick`, declared at worksheet.ts:277-289 and defaulted to `false` at worksheet.ts:328, plumbed via `Options.openLinksOnClick` (spreadsheet.ts:25-41, 91). The exact remediation the reviewer proposes is already in the code. The three cited surfaces do not set the flag: datasource-view.tsx:62-66, lakehouse-view.tsx:111-115, revision-preview.tsx:471-475 all pass only `{ theme, store, readOnly: true }`, so `openLinksOnClick` resolves to false and a plain click still reaches the selection path; only Ctrl/Cmd+click opens a link there. The only opt-in caller is the editor surface sheet-view.tsx:1052. Tests at packages/sheets/test/view/worksheet-links.test.ts:252,310,375 confirm the flag is required for modifier-free opening. Code is not present as described.
